name: Blues Alley - InstantSeats
notes: Migrated off the changedetection pod (see docs/ISSUE_LOG.md) - InstantSeats confirmed requests-fetchable in that investigation, no browser needed. Event-level extraction means boilerplate (Event Info / Get Tickets / status text) never becomes part of a diffed record, so ignore_contains is unused here (kept blank; it only applies to kind=artist raw text diffs). Relevance is scored via score_candidates.py (Last.fm/MusicBrainz, same pipeline and cache as the weekly HFTB diff) after a free pre-filter on Blues Alley's own genre-series labels (Chilean/Brazilian Jazz Series, Hispanic Heritage Jazz Month, etc. are auto off-profile, no API call). Extractor calibrated from historical diff evidence, not a live fetch - verify its first real run against the actual page.

name: Danielle Ponder - Tour (Seated API)
notes: Wrapper page (danielleponder.com/tour) is JS-only - the Seated widget's tour-events block is client-injected and never appears in a plain fetch. Watching the underlying cdn.seated.com JSON API directly instead, confirmed publicly fetchable with no auth (found via Claude-for-Chrome network inspection 2026-09-19). Empty-state shape verified live ("tour-events":{"data":[]}); populated shape inferred from the JSON:API spec the response declares, not yet observed live - worth a look once she has a real date. Generalizes to any Seated-embedding artist: find their cdn.seated.com/api/tour/<uuid> call once via network inspection, then watch that directly instead of the wrapper page.

name: Hamilton Live - Calendar
notes: Set up as a backstop for venues with unreliable email alerts, per Dan. Confirmed live 2026-09-19 via Claude-for-Chrome DOM inspection - fully server-rendered, semantic markup, no JS gap. Extractor cross-validated two independent ways against the real live page before commit (a DOM query walk and the exact regex-chunking approach the extractor uses, both run in-browser) - both agreed exactly, 48 events. No off-profile pre-filter defined - general-purpose venue with a genuinely mixed bill, no free negative-signal marker the way Blues Alley's own genre-series labels serve as one; untracked bookings go straight to score_candidates.py. Given real booking volume, expect some [filtered] noise most weeks even in steady state - working as intended, not a broken watch.

name: JVs Restaurant - Calendar Flyer
notes: Calendar is posted as flyer images with no extractable text - OCR is out of scope for this system. The venue's own filename convention embeds the month (JV_NEW_FLYER_DESIGN_<MONTH>_<YEAR>_...), confirmed via plain fetch 2026-09-19; a live-browser DOM query shows something different (client-side JS swaps the image to inline base64 post-load) but that JS never runs in a headless fetch, so it does not affect this. Goal is deliberately coarse - nudge Dan to go look, not extract show data. The mail body shows the old/new image URLs; the month is visible right in the filename. ignore_contains excludes the venue's static "how to book us" flyer (JV_BOOKING.jpg) on the same page, which is unrelated and would otherwise fire a false alert if it ever changed. Taste-profile matches at this venue (JP Soars, Gabe Stillman, Albert Castiglia) are underplays among open-mic/cover-band bookings - this watch cannot see which month has one, only that a new month went up; the actual check is still manual.
